Lena (AE): Heads-up: Pricing v4 goes live tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need guidance for a POC that expires in 9 days — customer asks for 12-month renewal at old Starter rate.
Marco (Sales Ops): Grandfathering applies if renewal signed within 30 days. Add note `grandfathering:yes` on quote.
Ivy (Pricing): Confirmed. For CPQ use template v2026-03-19 so the `grandfathering` flag flows into billing.
Sam (Deal Desk): Exceptions: submit row in exceptions sheet with ARR, signed date, AE. We aim for 48h turnaround; >$200k escalate.
Lena (AE): Can Legal provide a short clause we can include in customer messages?
Tara (Legal): Draft: "We will honor existing committed pricing for renewals executed within 30 days of our pricing update. Exceptions require Deal Desk approval."
Marco (Sales Ops): Added AcmeHealth row to exceptions sheet and tagged `priority`. Link pinned.
AutoNoticeBot: automated: pricing-v4-exceptions.csv uploaded https://drive.company/pricing/pricing-v4-exceptions.csv
Ivy (Pricing): Also note promo codes tied to Starter convert to one-time credits unless listed in exceptions.
Sam (Deal Desk): Noted. We'll fast-track `priority` tags and confirm within 48h.
Lena (AE): Thanks all — I'll send the customer line and request the PO today.
Marco (Sales Ops): I'll push CPQ patch to sandbox tonight and run smoke tests.
